decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent desk system matching the firm's move toward flexible workplace interiors, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough and the firm's hiring and R&D suggest enough slack to retain it.

A chair family is very close to the established premium furniture range, so in a stable industry this is the kind of product management would usually keep unless results were clearly below aspiration.

The floor cushions are more niche and their performance is more uncertain, but because they still build on the firm's interior concept and the firm appears to have organizational slack, management is somewhat more likely to keep than drop them.
The upholstered sofa is close to the core offer and received a stronger presentation in 2019, which suggests acceptable early reception and supports retention under a satisficing logic.
The high standing table fits the firm's office and conference portfolio and current demand for adaptable work settings, so it likely stays above the aspiration threshold for continuation.

Because the rug collection is the most distant from the firm's established offer, management is more likely to reallocate resources away from it if results are even modestly below aspiration despite some available slack.
